prompt:
Create a NEW illustration of BARRET WALLACE from FINAL FANTASY VII for the Kalistar card game. Reference 1 supplies Barret's recognizable face, dark skin, very powerful build, short flat-top hair, beard, worn brown sleeveless vest, dog tags, olive cargo trousers and RIGHT-FOREARM multi-barrel gun prosthesis. Reference 2 is the approved Aeris illustration: match its Kalistar art direction and emotional storytelling, not her pose or scenery.

SCENE: an iconic, emotionally devastating moment after the Sector 7 plate collapse in Midgar. Barret stands braced amid broken concrete on an elevated piece of wreckage, slightly hunched with the weight of grief, turning his face three-quarter toward us and upward toward the hole in the collapsed plate. His heavy gun-arm is lifted diagonally up beside him, barrels just fired toward the empty sky, a thin curl of smoke escaping; do not have it obscure his face. His human LEFT fist clenches a torn little pink ribbon at chest height, a small, understated reminder of the people he is desperate to protect. Eyes visible without sunglasses covering them (sunglasses pushed onto forehead), glistening, eyebrows drawn together, mouth open in a raw shout of grief and rage, a single subtle tear cutting through ash on his cheek. No comedic grimace, no scream horror, no villain sneer. Convey the terrifying strength and wounded heart of a father who refuses to abandon his family. Strong, believable action and asymmetry, no generic hero posing. No other foreground character, no gore.

COMPOSITION: vertical 4:5 painting, framed from the knees up for an expressive face readable in a small game card. Keep face at x=48-57% y=24-32%, central torso and clenched left hand visible; keep entire main gun muzzle and emotional gesture inside central 78% of image so card stat columns will not obscure them. The lifted cannon may tilt toward image left but not leave the image. Clear readable silhouette. Background atmospheric and simplified, not overloaded: a few immense broken steel beams, distant rubble and dust, and a large dramatic opening to pale warm dawn above cold gray industrial ruins. Visually recognizable Midgar aftermath, not generic flames everywhere. Cool gray/teal shadows, warm pale sunlight touching face, copper rust accents; quiet background that supports the emotional figure.

KALISTAR GOLDEN RULE: detailed narrative fantasy PAINTING, expressive visible brushstrokes and clean painted color planes, weathered fabric and metal, motivated cinematic light, controlled detail and lost/found edges. EXACT same family as approved reference Aeris and existing Barret. Neither photorealistic, film still, 3D render, anime nor manga. No uniform digital noise, no oversharpening, no smoky face obscuring emotion. Illustration only: absolutely no text, lettering, logos, frame, game UI, numbers, borders, panel divisions or card elements. Anatomically correct one head, two legs, one human left arm and one right prosthetic gun arm. Face, clothing and prosthesis remain unmistakably Barret.
